public_body: South Hadley Electric Light Department Board Of Commissioners
overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by creating insufficiently detailed executive session minutes for December 20, 2022, ordered amended minutes and compliance, and declined to review the Board's Purpose 10 claim.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the minutes of the Board's December 20, 2022 executive session on contract negotiations were insufficiently detailed.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by creating insufficiently detailed minutes of the executive session meeting held on December 20, 2022.

allegations.summary: The Board asserted that part of its executive session discussion also fell under Purpose 10 (trade secrets for a municipal energy aggregator); the AG did not review this.
allegations.key_passage: We do not review whether the Board convened in executive session for a proper purpose as that issue was not raised in the complaint but  note our concern that the notice only indicated that the Board would convene in executive session under Purpose 2.

remedy: Within 30 days, amend the December 20, 2022 executive session minutes to accurately summarize the discussion of the Manager's contract, and certify to the AG within 30 days that this was done.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
remedy_passage: We order the Board, within 30 days of the date of this letter, to amend the minutes of its December 20, 2022, executive session to accurately summarize its discussion of the Manager's contract and to certify to this office within thirty (30) days of the date of this letter that it has done so.
